en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 11. My father and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (RA) both said: Sa`d ibn `Abd Allah said, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn `Isa, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abu `Umayr, on the authority of Hisham ibn Salim, on the authority of Abu Basir that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said: “

Whoever is offered the means to perform the pilgrimage, even if it means riding on the back of a mutilated, mangled tailed donkey has the means of performing the pilgrimage, even if he refuses the offer.”
